newsitem.title: UK: London platinum fixes at lowest level since Nov 2, '93.
newsitem.headline: London platinum fixes at lowest level since Nov 2, '93.

text.p: Platinum dropped to its lowest fixing since November 2, 1993 on Friday reflecting the weak start to the new year in the precious metals markets.
It fixed at $366.50 per ounce down from $369.00 on the first trading day of the year on Thursday.
Dealers said platinum demand was suffering from substitution by its much cheaper sister metal palladium in key end-use areas like autocatalyst coatings for the car industry.
"There is plenty of material around," one dealer said, adding that speculators had shown little interest in the metal recently.
